ABOUT US

Honouring the Wisdom of the Ancestors

Luo Ancestral Covenant is an ancestral and traditional knowledge institution rooted in the Luo heritage of Kenya. We preserve and share indigenous African knowledge through ancestral education, cultural guidance and traditional herbal knowledge.

Our service is open to people from every nation, ethnicity, language, religion and cultural background. We respect the uniqueness of each family's ancestral lineage and cultural heritage.

Our Philosophy

Every family has a story and every lineage has traditions worth understanding and preserving. Our approach begins with respectful consultation and cultural understanding.
